findings.why: repair_tail raises an uncaught ValueError/TypeError when the tail line parses to non-dict JSON (e.g. "foo", 123, null, [...]), because line_hash calls dict(line); AD-12 step 3 requires such a line to be refused (file untouched, corruption reported), not to crash the CLI with a traceback instead of exit 5.

the 'last byte is not \n' disjunct of FR-10/AC-1 is not implemented — a complete final line missing its trailing newline is treated as clean no-op. This follows AD-12 step 1 and requirements.md §7 (AND), but contradicts the literal OR in FR-10/AC-1, and no AC-1 test covers that branch. Spec contradiction to surface, not a code bug.
